reviews.title: Deleting peoples accounts for no reason
reviews.body:
I am filing this complaint regarding Instagram’s ongoing mishandling of user accounts, repeated technical errors, and unfair restrictions placed on users.

Instagram has repeatedly restricted people’s ability to use basic features, including sending and replying to direct messages, sometimes even after the platform has removed the restriction or indicated that the account is no longer restricted.

Users and myself are also experiencing accounts being disabled, suspended, or deleted without clear explanations or valid reasons. These issues are extremely frustrating, especially when people follow the platform’s rules and support this platform and still find themselves losing access to their accounts or important features.

In my own experience, my messaging restriction was removed, but I still cannot properly send or reply to messages. This makes me question why Instagram continues to make these mistakes without providing users with a proper way to resolve them.

Instagram needs to take accountability for these repeated issues, improve its account review system, stop incorrectly restricting users, and provide actual customer support instead of leaving people without answers.

I am requesting that Meta investigate these ongoing problems, review its account enforcement practices, fix the technical errors affecting messaging, and provide users with a reliable way to appeal decisions and receive assistance.

reviews.title: Removing useful features - what are you doing?
reviews.body:
Removing the ability to press and hold the screen to pause Reels was a step backward. Forcing users into tapping to pause only makes it much harder to catch specific frames quickly without dealing with playback delays or accidentally liking the video.

Tapping to pause is fine for longer viewing, while pressing and holding is far better for quick pauses and reading fast on screen text without a play icon blocking the video. There is no reason these two features cannot coexist. Bring back the hold gesture and let users use both options.

reviews.title: banned for no reason
reviews.body:
I am writing to request assistance regarding the disabling of five of my Instagram accounts on October 24, 2026. I believe these accounts were wrongfully disabled, and I have been unable to obtain meaningful support or a fair opportunity to appeal the decisions.

The affected accounts are:

meliallure
miasvis
hennaa.allure
molancoli
dragwop
Instagram stated that my accounts violated its policies concerning child nudity. I strongly dispute this allegation. I have not posted the content that Instagram appears to be accusing me of posting, and I believe my accounts may have been incorrectly flagged or reviewed.

This situation is especially concerning because one of the affected accounts, hennaa.allure, is connected to my art and henna business. Losing access to this account affects more than my personal social media use; it also interferes with my ability to maintain my business presence, communicate with customers, showcase my work, and promote my services.

I have repeatedly attempted to appeal the disabling of my accounts, but Instagram tells me that I cannot appeal the decisions. I have not been provided with a workable way to challenge the allegations, speak with a representative, or obtain an explanation of the specific content that supposedly violated its policies. I have also been unable to file a complaint directly with Instagram because I cannot access an effective reporting or support channel.

Additionally, every new Instagram account I attempt to create is disabled within 24 hours. All five of my original accounts were associated with the same email address and phone number. This has left me effectively unable to use the platform or establish an alternative account while trying to resolve the situation.

I understand the importance of protecting children and enforcing online safety policies. However, I believe users should have access to a fair review process when serious allegations are made against them, particularly when they dispute the allegations and cannot reach anyone to address the matter.

I am respectfully asking the Maryland Attorney General’s Office to review my complaint, determine whether your office can assist with this dispute, and help me identify a way to bring this matter to Meta’s attention. Specifically, I am requesting assistance in obtaining a meaningful review of the five disabled accounts, clarification regarding the alleged violations, and restoration of my accounts if the enforcement decisions were made in error.

I would also appreciate any guidance your office can provide regarding my inability to access Instagram’s appeal and complaint processes and the impact this situation has had on my business account.

I can provide screenshots of the disabling notices, records of my attempts to appeal, and documentation connecting the affected accounts to my business.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I hope your office can help me find a fair way to resolve this issue.

reviews.title: Lack of reviewing!!
reviews.body:
I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with how Meta has handled my accounts. My Instagram account was suspended, and I immediately submitted an appeal. However, despite submitting my appeal, I have been left waiting without a proper update or resolution.
What makes this situation even more unacceptable is that my Facebook account was also suspended because of my Instagram account's alleged violation. These are separate platforms, yet the suspension of one account has affected my access to another. As a result, I am also having difficulty accessing my COD Mobile and Mobile Legends accounts, which are connected to my Facebook login.
I understand that platforms have rules and policies that users are expected to follow. However, I believe it is unfair to suspend multiple accounts and disrupt access to other services while my original Instagram appeal is still pending. Users deserve transparency, timely reviews, and fair treatment instead of being left waiting with no meaningful updates.
I am asking Meta to review this system and reconsider how account suspensions across its platforms are handled. A violation involving one account should not automatically cause a chain reaction that affects other accounts and services, especially when the original case is still under appeal.
This experience has caused unnecessary frustration and inconvenience. I hope Meta takes this complaint seriously and improves its appeal process, account review system, and the way it handles linked accounts.

reviews.title: Not helpful
reviews.body:
My Honest Review of Instagram in India

Instagram in India does not seem to provide a fair and equal platform for every creator. It feels like new and small creators are being ignored, while accounts with millions of followers receive more visibility and engagement.

Many new creators work extremely hard to create original and quality content, but their reach and views are constantly pushed down. Some creators also face unexpected account suspensions or restrictions without proper explanations.

It raises serious concerns about Instagram’s transparency, fairness, and content policies. There is a growing perception that the platform favors certain media narratives and influential accounts while suppressing the voices of independent and emerging creators.

Creators should have the freedom to express their opinions, including criticism of government policies, without fearing unfair account suspensions, reduced reach, or restrictions.

Instagram and Meta should stop treating creators differently based on their popularity or opinions. Every creator deserves equal opportunities, fair reach, transparent policies, and freedom of expression.

Instagram should support new creators, not suppress them. We need a fair platform, not a platform that only benefits already-famous accounts.

reviews.title: Продвижение
reviews.body:
Я недовольна тем, как Instagram продвигает контент начинающих блогеров.

Я регулярно создаю качественный контент, готовлю карусели, снимаю Reels, вкладываю время, силы и творческую энергию в развитие своего блога. Но мои публикации практически не получают охвата. Контент не показывается новой аудитории, а значит, у начинающих авторов практически нет возможности привлечь подписчиков и заявить о себе.

Возникает закономерный вопрос: как новому блогеру развиваться, если его публикации не получают достаточного распространения? Получается замкнутый круг: чтобы тебя показывали, нужна активная аудитория, но чтобы набрать аудиторию, нужно, чтобы тебя показывали.

Создаётся впечатление, что преимущество получают аккаунты с уже большой аудиторией, а новым авторам крайне сложно пробиться.

Instagram должен предоставлять равные возможности для развития всем создателям контента, независимо от количества подписчиков. Хотелось бы видеть более справедливую систему рекомендаций, при которой качественный и интересный контент действительно получает шанс быть замеченным новой аудиторией.

Я хочу развивать свой блог на этой платформе, но при нынешней ситуации мотивация продолжать создавать контент заметно снижается.

Subject: URGENT – Business Account Disabled – Immediate Review Requested

Dear Instagram Support Team,

I am urgently requesting a manual review of my business account @parsanelectric, which was disabled on November 18, 2026.

This is not a personal account. It is the official business account of Parsan Electric, a real manufacturing business that produces and sells lighting products.

Our Instagram account is our primary communication channel with customers. Since its sudden deactivation, thousands of our customers can no longer find us, contact us, or follow up on their purchases.

Most importantly, we currently have active customer orders and ongoing business commitments. Our customers are unable to reach us, receive updates about their orders, or communicate with our business. This situation is seriously affecting our customers, our reputation, and our daily operations.

We have invested significant time and effort into building this business account and establishing trust with our customers.

I strongly believe this deactivation may have been a mistake. I respectfully request that your team conduct a thorough manual review of @parsanelectric and reconsider this decision.

We are fully willing to provide any documents, business information, or verification necessary to confirm our ownership and the legitimacy of our business.

Please understand that this account is essential to our business operations, and every additional day of inaccessibility causes further damage to our business and inconveniences our customers.

I sincerely ask you not to treat this as an ordinary account issue, but as an urgent business matter requiring human review.

Thank you for your attention and understanding.

Best regards,
Parsan Electric

reviews.title: Extremely poor support and unfair account deletion
reviews.body:
My Instagram account  was disabled, and despite submitting the requested video selfie immediately after the suspension, I never received any response or confirmation that it had been reviewed.

So my account was deleted, my appeal was apparently ignored, and I was penalized for a delay that was entirely beyond my control.

What makes this even worse is that contacting Instagram support is virtually impossible. There is no reliable way to reach a real person, explain the situation, or get a meaningful response.

An app used by millions of people for personal and professional purposes should have a functioning support system. Losing years of work because of an apparent mistake, with no opportunity to speak to anyone, is unacceptable.

Extremely disappointed with Meta and Instagram.

reviews.title: Better privacy options would be nice
reviews.body:
I'd like to suggest adding customizable Story audience lists and fixing in-app glitches.

When trying to restore an accidentally deleted story from "Recently Deleted" within the 24-hour window, the app repeatedly fails with a "Network Error: Your video wasn't restored" message—even on strong Wi-Fi and cellular data, and after logging out and reinstalling. Because the story used the weekly Spotlight feature, deleting it also wasted the weekly Spotlight allowance with no way to recover the post. Please fix the server sync bug on Recently Deleted stories.


Currently, Instagram offers Close Friends or the option to hide Stories from individual accounts. However, there is no practical way to create multiple custom audiences.

It would be extremely useful to allow users to create and name their own audience lists (for example: friends, acquaintances, professional contacts etc) and share Stories with those audiences without displaying a special indicator that reveals they're on a particular list.

Close Friends feels limited. Sometimes users simply want more control over who sees specific content without making the audience selection obvious such as the green circle indicator. 

The hide story from option isn’t ideal when you have to manually select each person and you have hundreds to over one thousand followers.

Please consider adding discreet, customizable private audience lists. This would give users significantly more flexibility and control over their privacy.

reviews.title: Algorithmic Abuse
reviews.body:
Instagram is constantly showing incredibly disturbing and abusive content to me despite my lack of interaction and my active effort in using the platform’s options of saying “uninterested” and “don’t show me this type of content”.
I’m a male survivor of SA and DV and I’ve talked about it on my profile, my posts, and in my messages on the platform - so META’s algorithm knows this.
Almost every single time I open the app, I am constantly shown posts mocking male survivors, denying and belittling their abuse, or outright celebrating domestic violence and sexual assault against men.
These algorithms rely on emotional manipulation of users to maintain their attention so they’ll stay on the platform longer. It’s disgusting. It’s incredibly harmful and I’m so tired of trying to use META’s platforms to stay in contact with friends and family and to connect with support networks and other survivors but instead being constantly bombarded with abusive material and emotionally manipulative algorithms banking on its manipulation to create more profit and data acquisition from its users.

reviews.title: DISAPPOINTED
reviews.body:
am extremely disappointed and frustrated with Instagram and the way they are handling their age verification system. At this point, this is becoming completely unacceptable. Instagram keeps flagging my account because of its AI age detection system, claiming that I may be underage, even though I have repeatedly provided identification to verify my age. What exactly is the point of having an ID verification process if the platform is going to ignore the verification and continue restricting or banning accounts anyway?

I understand that Instagram has rules and policies regarding age restrictions, and I understand that protecting younger users is important. However, there is a major difference between enforcing safety policies and repeatedly punishing users because an automated system keeps making mistakes. AI is not perfect, and it should not have the power to repeatedly flag, restrict, or disable someone’s account without a proper human review.

The most frustrating part is that I am actually trying to cooperate with the verification process. I am doing what Instagram asks me to do. I am submitting identification when requested, following the instructions, and trying to resolve the issue. Yet somehow, I continue running into the exact same problem. It feels like I am going in circles with a system that does not actually listen to its users or properly recognize the information being submitted.

Instagram needs to understand how frustrating this experience is. People put time, effort, memories, conversations, and personal content into their accounts. Having an account repeatedly disabled or banned because of an automated age detection system is not a small inconvenience. It can mean losing access to important messages, pictures, connections, and years of content. Users should not have to constantly worry about losing access to their accounts when they have already followed every verification step requested of them.

Another major issue is the lack of proper customer support. When something like this happens, users deserve a clear explanation of what went wrong and an actual opportunity to speak with someone who can review the situation. Sending people through the same automated process over and over again is not a real solution. If Instagram is going to use AI to make decisions that affect people’s accounts, there needs to be a reliable way to challenge those decisions and have an actual human investigate the issue.

I am asking Instagram to seriously reconsider how its age verification and account enforcement systems work. Stop relying entirely on automated decisions when those decisions can clearly be incorrect. Improve the verification process, provide better customer support, and make sure that submitted identification is actually reviewed properly.

Users should not have to repeatedly prove themselves just to keep an account they have already verified. If someone submits the requested documentation, Instagram should provide a clear response instead of continuing to flag and disable the account without properly explaining why.

This is not just about one account. It is about how Instagram treats its users and how little control people seem to have when automated systems make mistakes. A platform with millions of users should have a much better system in place than this.

I genuinely hope Instagram takes complaints like this seriously because the current experience is unacceptable. Please improve the AI age detection system, provide real human support, review accounts fairly, and stop repeatedly penalizing users for errors made by your own automated systems.

At this point, I am beyond frustrated. I should not have to keep submitting my identification all day long just to have the same issue happen again. DO BETTER, INSTAGRAM.

Since when does Instagram encourage fake accounts and impersonation???

Some random guy created a fa

Since when does Instagram encourage fake accounts and impersonation???

Some random guy created a fake account, posts pictures of my brother, follows all of his relatives, and even shares private photos of my brother that aren’t even posted on my brother’s own profile! We have absolutely no idea where he got them!

My brother posted a Story warning everyone that this account is fake and that it’s NOT him. Nobody has any idea WHO this person is!

All of us (including his family and friends) started reporting and blocking the account for impersonating a real person. But Instagram does absolutely nothing! Their response is that this weird guy hasn’t violated any of their community guidelines!

Seriously??? Isn’t this a violation of Instagram’s Terms of Service??? Since when did pretending to be someone else and stealing their photos become acceptable and completely consequence-free behavior???

reviews.title: Give users more editing power to make this a 5/5 !!!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.body:
I would love to see a feature that allows users to edit 
a carousel post to add new photos days or weeks after it has been published—similar to how Facebook allows post editing.
Why this is useful:
I recently received late/additional photos from my photography studio that didn’t make the initial cut but would perfectly complement an existing carousel.
To me, Instagram is like my personal diary, and it would be incredibly meaningful to look back on these complete memories in the future. Right now, my only options are to delete the post entirely and lose all the initial engagement or create a completely separate post. Allowing users to append new photos to an existing carousel would beautifully preserve our memories in one place.

reviews.body:
I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with Instagram. Having my account suspended without a fair explanation or a proper opportunity to resolve the issue is completely unacceptable.

Instagram makes it incredibly difficult to get in touch with an actual person, leaving users stuck dealing with automated responses and appeals that seem to go nowhere. People invest years building their accounts, creating memories, connecting with friends and family, and growing businesses, only to have everything taken away without proper communication or support.

The lack of transparency, customer service, and accountability is ridiculous. Users deserve clear explanations, fair treatment, and a real opportunity to appeal decisions.

Instagram needs to do better. You cannot expect people to trust a platform that can suspend their accounts without providing meaningful support or answers.

reviews.title: Scary Overreach
reviews.body:
One automated age-verification decision erased my family’s access across Meta, with no meaningful way to reach a human.

On November 2, 2026, Instagram suspended my 13-year-old son’s account for allegedly being underage. We immediately submitted his passport through the requested verification process. The system rejected it within minutes and said his account and data would be deleted. We attempted the offered data download, but nothing came through.

My own Instagram account was also suspended without an explanation. Every attempt to log in and appeal redirects me to my son’s permanently suspended page. Customer service requests submitted on November 3 produced automated instructions requiring access to accounts we cannot enter.

My Facebook, Threads, and WhatsApp accounts were also affected. An apparent error involving one account has severed my access to my community across multiple services.

The most alarming part is the reach of this automated decision and the absence of an accessible human review. Meta accepted a passport submission, rejected the age it documents, and left us without a workable appeal. A company with this much control over people’s communications needs a functioning process to correct its mistakes.

reviews.title: META: WHERE CREATIVITY GOES TO DIE
reviews.body:
Congratulations, Mark Zuckerberg. You’ve built a billion-dollar platform where actual creators get punished while bots, scammers, stolen content, and recycled garbage seem to thrive.

I spent countless hours researching Warhammer lore, writing stories, editing videos, and generating thousands of images to produce something worth watching.

Yes, I use AI. I never hid that. But apparently, Meta is happy to promote AI as the future while treating independent creators who actually use it like criminals.

Eight of my videos were removed after reports. Hours of dedication wiped away while Instagram’s moderation system apparently operates with the intelligence of a malfunctioning toaster.

And Mark Zuckerberg? The man trying to build the metaverse can’t even build a platform where creators feel protected from abusive reporting and unpredictable enforcement.

Meta doesn’t empower creators. It exhausts them.

Your moderation is a joke, your transparency is nonexistent, and your customer support feels like shouting into the void.

You don’t need another AI revolution, Mark. You need a functioning appeal system.

One star. I’d give zero, but apparently even Instagram has standards somewhere.

Sincerely,
A creator who made the mistake of giving a damn.

reviews.title: Formal Complaint: Repeated Unjustified Account Suspensions and Request for Manual Review
reviews.body:
I am writing to express my serious concerns regarding instagram’s current account moderation and suspension system.

Instagram was once a platform I genuinely enjoyed using, particularly for connecting with others who shared similar interests and participating in fan communities. Unfortunately, my recent experiences have significantly damaged my trust in the platform.

I previously managed approximately five fan accounts, each containing followers, friendships, stories, and content thay I had invested considerable time and effort into developing. Despite clearly identifying these accounts as fan pages and not attempting to impersonate anyone, they were repeatedly subjected to messaging restrictions and eventual suspensions.

What concerns me most is the apparent lack of thorough investigation before such severe restrictions are imposed. Even newly created accounts have experienced similar issues, leaving me frustrated and uncertain how to participate on the platform without facing further penalties. 

I am formally requesting that Instagram review these suspensions, investigate whether its automated moderation system is incorrectly flagging legitimate fan accounts, and provide a clear explanation of the specific policies my accounts allegedly violated. 

Users should not have to repeatedly lose their accounts, communities, and personal efforts Without receiving a transparent explanation or meaningful opportunity to resolve the issue.

I understand the importance of enforcing community guidelines and maintaining a safe platform. However, moderation shouod be fair, consistent, and supported by an appropriate review process. reviews.title: Locked out of my account and I wasn't even hacked. Please help
reviews.body:
On October 29, 2026, I tried to change the email address associated with my account. The change did not seem to go through and, instead, my account was locked "to protect [me] from hacking." (In fairness, I had just been checking the passwords on some of my other, very old accounts, so maybe the act of logging in and out of multiple accounts that quickly looked suspicious. But I promise it was just me.)

When I tried to get back into my account and the app told me it was locked, it offered me only two options for recovery: a video selfie, or "get help from friends". I tried the video selfie first and during the entire process of submitting it I was never asked to enter a "secure email address" and I was never told how long the selfie actually takes to review (which is why I tried it again multiple times after that: it said "We couldn't verify your identity" so I just thought the first one didn't work). So then I tried the "get help from friends", and by sheer luck it happened to select two people I am even still in regular contact with. I explained the situation to both of them and asked them to look out for the notification. They never got anything. According to stories we found from many people who tried using this feature, it is very prone to NOT WORKING AT ALL: either the two friends never get a notification, or when they confirm the person's identity, the person never gets a reset password link.

At a complete loss for what else to do, and afraid of losing access to my account for good, I opened the support page on my laptop and tried to figure out if there was any way I could contact someone about the situation. While the pages it showed me had relevant information, it wasn't actually getting me anywhere because those suggestions were the things I had already done and weren't working. With no other option to turn to I had to try to ask questions and explain the situation to the Meta AI assistant. At first it didn't even know the feature I was talking about. Once I actually got it to understand what I was looking at, explained that I was getting stuck in a loop, and when can I expect the selfie results, and hey if I never input a secure email does it go to the email associated with my account? And so on and so forth. At one point it even offered to connect me with a human support agent! So I told it yes, please connect me to a support agent! And it said it couldn't. At this point I am willing to bet it's programmed to offer that and then act like it "just can't right now, because of backend stuff, but I promise it's totally a possible thing that happens and we totally have human representatives you can usually talk to, for sure, definitely, but not right now."

There doesn't seem to be a support phone number I can call, but even if there was, I'm sure it would just be an AI that forces you through a bunch of navigational trees.

I'm out of ideas. I'm extremely frustrated and disappointed with the quality of support service Meta has provided. I'm  scared of losing my account. I just wanted to change an email address. At this point, I don't even care about that anymore. I just want my account back. Please for the love of god if any human staff member at Instagram is reading this, my username is dualitysdownfall and the email address associated with my account WORKS JUST FINE FOR NOW. Please contact me there and help me get back into my Instagram Account. I'm at my wit's end.

reviews.title: Stop Forcing AI Upon US!!!
reviews.body:
I’ve been using IG before Meta owned it many years ago… but these days social media just feels very passive aggressive with how artists, small businesses, and other niche content creators can open up and express themselves (let alone make connections). 

The scraping of uploaded content/links for Meta’s AI model and the fact that it is forced to is without a way to opt out is… una-MUSE-ing! Forced algorithms are the only kind of meta that Meta likes to play around with. 

Why can’t the system go back to simple times while maintaining the convenient features and flexible customization on stories, posts, etc. This AI slop-fest needs to stop, or at the very least, be less invasive! 

TLDR: I am unaMUSEd with AI getting in my way (on behalf of real artists of many kinds!)

reviews.title: LOVE THIS APP
reviews.body:
I genuinely cannot put into words how much I adore this app.
Instagram is not just an app to me.
It is a lifestyle, a companion, a source of happiness, and quite frankly one of the greatest contributions to modern civilization. The Reels algorithm?
Absolutely phenomenal. Every single time I open this
app, I am greeted with exactly what my heart desires. It's almost concerning how well Instagram knows me. I could be having the worst day of my life, and somehow, within 3.7 seconds, I'm better. If l could give this app 10 stars, I would. If I could give it 100, I would.
Five stars simply does not begin to communicate the depth of my appreciation.
To the developers: Thank you.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for creating something so profoundly beautiful. Please never change the algorithm. Please never stop recommending videos that are suspiciously specific to my interests.
-AJ Chambers

reviews.title: Serious Concerns About Meta’s Role in Brazil’s Elections
reviews.body:
Instagram’s handling of political content surrounding Brazil’s elections raises serious concerns about transparency, content moderation, and the potential influence of Meta’s algorithms on democratic discourse.

Reports and allegations of inconsistent moderation, reduced visibility of political content, and selective enforcement deserve independent scrutiny and clear explanations from Meta.

When a platform has the power to influence what millions of citizens see, accountability is not optional. Decisions affecting political expression should be transparent, consistent, and open to independent oversight.

Meta’s lack of meaningful transparency undermines public confidence in both the platform and the integrity of online political discourse.

Brazilian users deserve better than opaque algorithms and corporate statements that fail to address legitimate concerns.

Meta must be held accountable for how its platforms handle election-related content. Public trust cannot exist without transparency.

reviews.title: Stop trying to expand Meta AI.
reviews.body:
Meta's insistence on exploiting the work and data of its public creators, the backbone of the entire platform, is not only an egregious overstep of intellectual property but an incredibly malicious practice that impacts the privacy and data of all end users regardless of their presence on Meta platforms.

Even overlooking the blatant disregard towards its end users, the fact that Meta is going to such lengths to try and expand the assets it is allowed to scrape by masquerading blanket "consent" to pull from content that is not posted to its platforms only signifies that the venture into AI infrastructure has been largely unsuccessful. The only conceivable reason a company would need to pull from outside resources is because of a failure to produce results with what has already been harvested, so this decisions reflects extremely poorly on Meta's success as a business. Additionally, seeing as there are no safeguards for content that gets shared or reposted (and ultimately fed into Meta's AI without the creator's consent), Meta is largely leaving itself open to a myriad of lawsuits for the unlawful distribution, invasion, and usage of work created by users not on their platforms. Given that many large corporations and their employees also utilize Meta platforms, it would be unsurprising if additional issues arose over the scraping of their data and content without explicit knowledge or permission. Furthermore, allowing Meta AI to access chats from business accounts not only breaches privacy but will ultimately deter users from utilizing these features all together.

Meta's decision to pursue these avenues reflects very poorly on the corporation as a whole, but also on the integrity and security of your products. Continuing to pursue these decisions will only continue to alienate large portions of your end users, which will ultimately lead to a decrease in usage of Meta products all together. Reconsider.

reviews.title: Privacy Policy
reviews.body:
Meta Is Profiting From Creators’ Work Without Their Consent.

Beginning October 30, 2026, Instagram is reportedly expanding its use of business account content to train artificial intelligence, while denying U.S. creators the opt-out protections available in other countries.

My creativity is not Meta’s property. My work is not free training material. And my privacy is not theirs to exploit.

I have invested countless hours building my audience, creating original content, and earning the trust of my followers. Now Meta intends to extract even more value from that work without my meaningful consent, compensation, or control.

Meta gets the data. Meta trains the AI. Meta collects the profits.

What do creators get? Nothing. Not even a choice.

This is an exploitation of the very people whose creativity helped build Instagram into a multibillion-dollar platform.

Creators deserve transparency, meaningful consent, the right to opt out, and fair compensation when their work is used commercially.

Our content has value. Our consent matters. And Meta should not get to decide otherwise.

One star.

reviews.title: Repeated Suspensions, Horrible Customer Service
reviews.body:
I’m extremely disappointed with Instagram’s account recovery process. My account, @heartz4niyaa_, was permanently disabled over an age-verification issue even though I am 16 and submitted my learner’s permit to verify my age. I was then told I could not request another review, and now I can’t even create a new account because I keep getting “Something went wrong” and “Try again later” errors.

I have contacted support multiple times, but I keep receiving the same explanations without a real solution. Users deserve a fair opportunity to resolve possible verification mistakes instead of being left without answers or access to support.

I want this issue taken seriously. If I cannot get a fair explanation or a reasonable way to resolve this matter, I am prepared to explore my legal options, including seeking legal advice about whether I have grounds to take legal action.

Instagram needs to improve its support system and provide a fair process for users who believe their accounts were disabled by mistake.

reviews.title: Overwhelmed with Spam
reviews.body:
Instagram has a serious spam issue. I report at least ten spam accounts a day for following me or “viewing” my stories. Enough is enough. Please get a handle on this. Also, every other post in my feed is an ad for garbage I don’t have any interest in, and if I hide the ad, another garbage ad replaces it. Don’t even get me started in the censoring issue. A lot of artists I follow get their artwork taken down on the regular, but somehow Insta can’t keep fake accounts from pestering me several times a day. I’ve been using Instagram for many years, and I can’t stress enough how much I long for the days before Facebook bought them. It’s my preferred social media, but if ever someone manages to replace them with a similar, less trash platform, I’ll be on that boat.

2026: The app has only gotten worse with more irrelevant content, an overwhelming amount of spam and ads, and less and less capabilities for finding new posts with hashtags. I rarely use it now and am amazed by just how far downhill it's gone.

reviews.title: Not the same
reviews.body: Instagram used to be a place where you could post pictures and your feed was filled with just what your friends/people you followed posted. Now your regular timeline is filled with ads and posts from people who you don’t follow and accounts that have large followings instead of placing these posts on the discovery feed where it’s supposed to be. Instagram was supposed to be the replacement for MySpace and even tumblr when it lost its clout, but now it’s a platform that is designed to make you addicted to it the same way TikTok does. Also hate that everything on any social media platform is AI. I don’t want to see AI anywhere and I didn’t ask for it either. All these big apps and companies keep shoving it down the consumer throat when we didn’t ask for any of these massive changes that takes the fun right out of social media. I miss when instagram was a digital diary instead of it being a popularity contest.

My account is marked “Locked.” Instagram tells me to update my email for security, but its recovery process repeatedly displays “Page isn’t available right now.”

I contacted support. Their response? They had no visibility into why my account was locked. They sent me back to the same recovery steps that had already failed—and then closed my case.

Closing a support case does not mean you solved the problem.

I’ve maintained this account for years. I’m willing to verify my identity and complete security checks, but Instagram needs to provide a process that actually works.

Meta: escalate this to someone who can fix the recovery errors and restore access. I have screenshots documenting the failures and the unresolved case closure. I want my account back, with its content and history intact.
